quotes.text: This is what I call data blindness. The data is not missing, but it is everywhere at once, which ends up being the exact same thing.

quotes.text: The paradox surfaces right here, more data without orchestration does not lead to better answers. It leads to worse ones.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters

quotes.text: Use the document's own structure as your primary signal. Don't just count tokens and cut, you need to build a hierarchy.

quotes.text: Governance is not optional. It is the difference between a working system and a massive legal liability.

quotes.text: If you treat this like a simple data problem, you're going to fail. Success comes when you treat it as an architecture problem instead.

chapters.title: Why standard RAG collapses at scale
Selective activation and recursive structure-aware chunking
Multimodal ingestion, entity extraction and knowledge graphs
Agentic routing, hybrid retrieval and permission-aware retrieval
Orchestration, cost, governance and real-world rollout
Failure modes, monitoring, future directions and key takeaways

takeaways: At millions of pages, plugging Copilot into data is not enough: a tiered selective-activation model plus recursive, structure-aware chunking with overlap beats expensive semantic chunking on cost and accuracy.
Precision comes from orchestration: an intent-based router, hybrid BM25 and vector retrieval fused with reciprocal rank fusion, cross-encoder reranking, rich metadata and knowledge graphs.
Governance and measurement must be built in from day one, including chunk-level permission trimming, sensitivity labels, retention, audit logs, latency budgets and gold-standard evaluation sets.
hook: Connecting Copilot to millions of documents does not make answers appear; without the right retrieval architecture, noise, latency and permission leaks take over. This episode is for architects and enterprise leaders planning Copilot or RAG at extreme scale. Learn how tiering, structure-aware chunking, hybrid retrieval, routing and built-in governance make massive datasets searchable and trustworthy.
